newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Philip Morris buy repeated.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Philip Morris buy repeated.

text.p: -- Oppenheimer analyst Roy Burry he reiterated a buy rating on Philip Morris Cos Inc.
-- said he expected cigarette consumption in the United States to be up one percent in 1996, compared with flat comparisons in 1994 and 1995.

-- Burry also expected a "better than 50-50 chance" that four legal developments will be favorable in the first half of 1997. He cited the Mississippi Medicaid case; a summary judgment hearing involving the Food and Drug Administration; a supreme court ruling in Florida; and a reversal in the Carter case in Florida.
-- shares rose 2-1/4 to 105-1/2 in Wednesday afternoon trading.
